subject: 🏃 Tuesday — Hip Complex Circuit + PT (Wk 9)
html:
Tomorrow: Hip Complex Circuit + PT (bodyweight, ~20 min) — shifted from Monday since yesterday's long run took that slot. Mobility and recovery only, no run, no load. The work: 90/90 switches, adductor rockbacks, glute bridges, quadruped hip CARs. If you have bands in BC, add the PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side); if not, skip the banded exercises — the bodyweight hip work still gets the job done.

Focus cue: Full range of motion, low effort. Give the legs a genuine day off after yesterday's 11.44 miles — you ran 1.44 mi over plan with a natural progressive finish, and the legs earned it. Move through the 90/90s and rockbacks slowly; this is restoration, not work.

Where you are: Week 9 of 12, Phase 3 — Peak Volume & Power. 26 days to the SF Marathon. The lean-in build starts now (~44 mi target this week). Yesterday's fueling breakthrough is the biggest single-day win of the back half: 4 gels + drink mix = 77 g/hr, GI perfectly clean — confirming the Presidio fix (Maurten hydrogel + caffeine front-loading + drink-mix sipping) works at easy-to-moderate effort. The remaining validation is gels at MP effort (HR 150–160), which comes Sunday on the 16-miler.

Looking ahead: Wednesday is 6×5-min road threshold reps by RPE (no track in BC, no H10 — effort-governed: hard/controlled, 7/10, can't hold a conversation). Rest and recover tomorrow to be ready for it. Knee 1/5 and hamstring clear — both stayed quiet through yesterday's longest run since Presidio.

Bed by 10. Hydrate well — yesterday's run was long and the travel days burn more than you think.
